notes: Twin Palms Short retains the middle Desert course with its northern undulations and eastern roundabout return, joined to the South Palm outer course. It excludes the North Palm extension, the South Palm inner technical loop, karting roads and pit access. Independently read public-domain 2022 NAIP pavement centers identify the full short branch sequence; route distance is unscaled and historical barriers and direction remain draft. The 2022 aerial centerline differs from the 3999 m catalogue scalar; the geometry is not scaled to match it. Independently digitized aerial centerline: 3904.7 m. Direction, historical configuration and fine corner alignment remain draft; no course coordinates come from the comparison catalogue.
